newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products calm after drop, gas oil bounces.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products calm after drop, gas oil bounces.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, seemingly in a struggle to establish new levels after Thursday's sharp losses, dealers said.

Gasoline was a little lower, having not fully accounted for NYMEX unleaded futures two cent a gallon fall on Thursday. Eurograde barges sold at $215.50 and $216.00, about $1 down from Thursday's close. Regular barges also traded, at $203.50 and $204.00, traders said.
Heating oil prices were up about $3 as IPE futures recovered some of Thursday's lost ground. The physical market was very quiet, storage talked around Nov IPE +$6/+$7 fob ARA.

Dealers sought the destination of the 170,800 tonnes of delivery against expired October futures. One German player was likely picking up 100,000 tonnes. A number of other parties, most with German interests, picked up the rest.
Diesel supply remained tight and product was barely offered.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady after initial signs of weakness. Stored material traded at $122.50 and $123.00, refinery at $124.00 and $124.50. Bunker demand was slack, below 10,000 tonnes for ARA, dealers said.
